name: Palantir Technologies

eyebrow.en: Palantir Technologies Inc. · Class A common stock · Aventura, Florida
eyebrow.zh: Palantir Technologies · A 类普通股 · 佛罗里达州阿文图拉

title.en: Data and AI software for the Pentagon and corporate America, growing faster at $8B than at $2B.
title.zh: 服务五角大楼与美国企业的数据和 AI 软件，规模 80 亿时比 20 亿时增长更快。

lede.en: Palantir sells software (Foundry, Gotham and its AI Platform, AIP) that lets governments and companies run decisions on their own data. Revenue grew 93% last quarter to $1.94B, led by US commercial sales up 149%, and the full-year guide was raised to about $8.15B. The catch is price: at a record $209 the stock is valued at about 62 times this year's revenue guide.
lede.zh: Palantir 销售让政府和企业基于自身数据做决策的软件（Foundry、Gotham 及 AI 平台 AIP）。上季营收增长 93% 至 19.4 亿美元，其中美国商业收入增长 149%，全年指引上调至约 81.5 亿美元。问题在于价格：股价创下 $209 的纪录，市值约为今年营收指引的 62 倍。

s.zh: GAAP 历史市盈率约 180 倍 · 预期约 90 倍

s.en: Q3 2026 · expected, after close · not yet confirmed
s.zh: 2026 第三季 · 预计盘后 · 公司尚未确认

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. Palantir fell from $207 in November 2025 to $107 in late June, then almost doubled after the Aug 3 report to a record close of $209.05 on Oct 9.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。Palantir 由 2025年11月的 $207 跌至 6月下旬的 $107，8月3日财报后几乎翻倍，10月9日以 $209.05 创收盘纪录。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with GAAP gross margin on the right axis. Palantir's fiscal year is the calendar year. GAAP operating margin swung from −23% in Q3 2021 to 47% as stock-based pay shrank relative to sales; Q4 2024 dips to 1% on a one-off stock compensation charge. The last bar is the midpoint of the Q3 2026 guide of $2.160–2.164B.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为 GAAP 毛利率。Palantir 财年与日历年一致。随着股权激励相对营收缩小，GAAP 营业利润率由 2021 第三季的 −23% 升至 47%；2024 第四季因一次性股权激励费用降至 1%。最后一根柱为 2026 第三季指引 21.60–21.64 亿美元的中值。

s.zh: 调整后营业利润率 62% · GAAP 47%
同比 +124% · 总剩余合同额 131 亿

p.en: US commercial bookings hit a record $2.13B (+153%) and the full-year guide now calls for at least $3.42B of revenue, up 134% or more.
p.zh: 美国商业签约额创纪录 21.3 亿美元（+153%），全年指引至少 34.2 亿美元营收，增长不低于 134%。

p.en: Q2 cash from operations was $1.22B, a 63% margin. Palantir holds $9.2B of cash and Treasuries, has no borrowings, and guides $4.5–4.7B of adjusted free cash flow this year.
p.zh: Q2 经营现金流 12.2 亿美元，利润率 63%。持有 92 亿美元现金及国债，无借款，今年调整后自由现金流指引 45–47 亿。

p.en: The Street expects about $2.18B, just above the $2.16B guide. Palantir beat the top of its guide by 5.7–8.7% in each of the last five quarters, yet the stock fell after two of those reports.
p.zh: 市场预期约 21.8 亿美元，略高于 21.6 亿指引。过去五季营收均超指引上限 5.7–8.7%，但其中两次财报后股价下跌。

p.en: The US is 81% of revenue. International commercial grew only 26%, so growth depends heavily on one country's companies and agencies.
p.zh: 美国占营收 81%。国际商业仅增长 26%，增长高度依赖美国企业和机构。

p.en: At about $502B the stock trades near 62 times this year's revenue guide and about 180 times trailing GAAP earnings. Any slowdown would hit a price like that hard.
p.zh: 市值约 5,020 亿美元，约为今年营收指引的 62 倍、GAAP 历史盈利的约 180 倍。增长一旦放缓，股价将大受冲击。

p.en: Stock-based compensation was $265M in Q2 (14% of revenue). It is the main gap between the 62% adjusted and 47% GAAP operating margin, and diluted shares (2.57B) run well above basic (2.40B).
p.zh: Q2 股权激励 2.65 亿美元（占营收 14%），是调整后 62% 与 GAAP 47% 营业利润率之间的主要差距；稀释股数（25.7 亿）明显高于基本股数（24.0 亿）。

p.en: Guide is $2.160–2.164B revenue and $1.292–1.296B adjusted operating income. Date not yet confirmed by the company.
p.zh: 指引营收 21.60–21.64 亿美元，调整后营业利润 12.92–12.96 亿。公司尚未确认日期。

p.en: The stopgap bill funds federal agencies to Dec 11. A full-year defense budget, or another extension, shapes new government awards.
p.zh: 临时拨款法案为联邦机构提供资金至12月11日。全年国防预算或再次延期将影响新的政府合同。

p.en: Full-year results and the first 2027 guide. The FY26 guide implies about $2.42B of Q4 revenue if Q3 lands at guidance.
p.zh: 全年业绩及首份 2027 指引。若 Q3 符合指引，FY26 指引隐含 Q4 营收约 24.2 亿美元。

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 9, 2026. For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Palantir Technologies Inc.
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月9日。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Palantir Technologies Inc. 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q3 2021 to Q2 2026. Palantir's fiscal year is the calendar year. This is GAAP free cash flow; Palantir's own 'adjusted' figure also adds back employer taxes on stock pay. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 2021 第三季至 2026 第二季共 20 个季度。Palantir 财年与日历年一致。此处为 GAAP 自由现金流；公司自报的“调整后”数字另加回股权激励相关的雇主税费。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

s.en: Jun 30, 2026 · incl. short-term Treasuries · no borrowings
s.zh: 2026年6月30日 · 含短期国债 · 无借款

read.en: Palantir spends almost nothing on equipment (capex was $15M in Q2), so free cash flow tracks operating cash flow. It rose from under $100M a quarter in 2021–22 to $1.2B in Q2 2026, and the last four quarters add up to about $3.4B. One caveat: stock-based pay ($265M in Q2) is a real cost to shareholders that never shows up as cash out, so free cash flow flatters the picture; after subtracting it, Q2 was still about $940M.
read.zh: Palantir 几乎不需设备投资（Q2 资本开支仅 1,500 万美元），自由现金流基本等于经营现金流。季度自由现金流由 2021–22 年不足 1 亿美元升至 2026 年 Q2 的 12 亿，近四季合计约 34 亿。需注意：股权激励（Q2 为 2.65 亿）是股东承担的真实成本，却不体现为现金流出，因此自由现金流显得更好看；扣除后 Q2 仍约 9.4 亿。

read.en: My base case uses the $4.5–4.7B full-year adjusted free cash flow guide. With about $2.1B already earned in the first half, the second half needs about $2.4–2.6B, which I split evenly, then let growth continue into 2027. That gives about $5.2B over four quarters. Collections are lumpy: Q1 2025 dropped to $304M from $457M the quarter before, so single quarters can miss.
read.zh: 我的基准情景采用 45–47 亿美元的全年调整后自由现金流指引。上半年已产生约 21 亿，下半年需约 24–26 亿，我平均分配，并让增长延续至 2027 年，四季合计约 52 亿。回款有波动：2025 年 Q1 由前一季的 4.57 亿降至 3.04 亿，单季可能不及预期。

p.en: The CFO flagged a seasonal jump in Q3 expenses from new-hire starts and marketing.
p.zh: CFO 提示 Q3 因新员工入职和营销支出会出现季节性增加。

p.en: Small: $19M in each of Q3 and Q4 2025 and none in the first half of 2026. They do not offset stock-pay dilution.
p.zh: 规模很小：2025 年 Q3、Q4 各 1,900 万美元，2026 上半年为零，不足以抵消股权激励稀释。

p.en: Only $7–15M a quarter; customers mostly run Palantir on cloud capacity they pay for.
p.zh: 每季仅 700 万至 1,500 万美元；客户大多在自己付费的云上运行 Palantir。

p.en: $6.24B of contracted US commercial revenue not yet recognised, up 124%.
p.zh: 美国商业已签约未确认收入 62.4 亿美元，增长 124%。

p.en: A 62% adjusted operating margin means most new revenue turns into cash.
p.zh: 调整后营业利润率 62%，新增营收大多转化为现金。

p.en: The $9.2B cash pile earned $78M of interest in Q2.
p.zh: 92 亿美元现金在 Q2 赚取 7,800 万利息。

bridgeNote.en: Palantir pays no dividend and buys back little stock, so cash keeps piling up. The real cost to owners is dilution from stock pay, not cash going out.
bridgeNote.zh: Palantir 不派息、回购很少，因此现金持续累积。股东的真正成本是股权激励带来的稀释，而非现金流出。
